prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: final high-definition transparent visual-novel character illustration for the existing game Sparks & Machines.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact approved gameplay boy, the authoritative identity, proportions, outfit and palette. Image 2 is the previous dialogue portrait, a face/clothes identity reference to improve on; it must NOT dictate its frontal torso pose. Image 3 is Hotaru, the companion, and the painterly finish reference.
Primary request: Paint the SAME boy as a beautiful, finished, high-quality full-body dialogue avatar. On screen he will stand at the RIGHT, talking to Hotaru at the LEFT. Turn his ENTIRE body together toward the LEFT: head, chest, both shoulders, belt, hips, knees and boots all in a natural left-facing three-quarter view. The near shoulder is clearly forward and the far shoulder recedes. His torso must visibly face left, not a frontal body with only the head or eyes turned. A relaxed standing conversational pose, arms resting naturally, attentive warm expression and gaze left toward the other speaker. Show the COMPLETE figure from hair tips to boot soles, with all hands and boots inside the canvas and comfortable margins.
Identity: tousled rich auburn-orange hair with the exact recognizable pointed locks; large warm brown eyes; fair youthful rounded face; short chibi storybook proportions matching Image 1, not an older or taller person. Teal short sleeved tunic with thick cream rolled cuffs and cream V-notch hem, ochre golden triangular scarf, plain brown leather belt with a square brass buckle, dark chocolate trousers, warm brown cuffed leather boots. No extra clothing, accessories, weapons or held props.
Style/finish: polished hand-painted storybook game illustration, crisp intentional dark brown contour lines, finely controlled brush shading, rich auburn hair volume, expressive clean face, convincing folds and leather/brass details. Match Hotaru's soft painterly material quality and gentle warm lighting while preserving the approved boy's cartoon proportions and exact design. Higher quality and more natural body staging than Image 2. Avoid flat vector coloring, plastic 3D, photorealism, blur, oversharpening or muddy texture.
Composition: a single complete figure centered on a vertical 1024x1536 or higher-resolution 2:3 canvas. Fill about 90% of canvas height; leave approximately 5% breathing space above the hair and below the boots and at least 7% at each side. Entire figure faces viewer-left. True RGBA transparent background; clean edge alpha only, no painted backdrop, aura, fog, glow cloud, ground plane, cast shadow, border, text, watermark, scenery or extra characters. Preserve the original references; this output is a new portrait asset only, not a replacement walk sprite.
